scenario.note: The total head of cattle in Year4 is capped at 100.
The head of cattle for Year4 is constrained to be no more than 100.
Two rules set absolute limits on the total sugar beet grown in Year5 and the total sugar beet sold across all years.
The first rule ensures that the total sugar beet grown in Year5 is at least 160 tons. The second rule limits the total sugar beet sold across all years to no more than 170 tons.
